app/llms-full.txt/route.ts.name: Full corpus text
app/llms-full.txt/route.ts.description: Joins the processed markdown of every docs page into one build-time text response.

app/llms.mdx/docs/[[...slug]]/route.ts.name: Page markdown mirror
app/llms.mdx/docs/[[...slug]]/route.ts.description: Serves a page's processed markdown at /llms.mdx/docs/<slug>/content.md; only prerendered paths exist, anything else 404s.

app/llms.txt/route.ts.name: Site index for LLMs
app/llms.txt/route.ts.description: Serves /llms.txt from Fumadocs' page index, reshaped to master's title, summary and one .md link per page.

app/og/docs/[...slug]/route.tsx.name: Docs social cards
app/og/docs/[...slug]/route.tsx.description: Prerenders a page's Open Graph PNG at /og/docs/<slug>/image.png from its title and description.

app/preview/[...slug]/route.ts.name: Link preview JSON
app/preview/[...slug]/route.ts.description: Prerenders the hover-card JSON for a page at /preview/<slug>/preview.json from its compiled structured data.

app/robots.ts.name: Robots rules
app/robots.ts.description: Emits robots.txt that allows every crawler, signals search and AI input yes but AI training no, and names the sitemap.

app/sitemap.ts.name: Page sitemap
app/sitemap.ts.description: Emits sitemap.xml with one absolute URL per routed page and its git last-modified date when the checkout has history.

GET /llms-full.txt.name: Fetch the whole docs
GET /llms-full.txt.description: Returns every page's title, URL and processed markdown in one text body.

GET /llms.mdx/docs/[[...slug]].name: Fetch page markdown
GET /llms.mdx/docs/[[...slug]].description: Returns the markdown twin of one docs page; /<slug>.md rewrites here.

GET /llms.txt.name: Fetch llms index
GET /llms.txt.description: Returns the llms.txt index: title, summary and a link to each page's markdown mirror, each page listed once.

GET /og/docs/[...slug].name: Fetch page social card
GET /og/docs/[...slug].description: Returns the 1200x630 PNG social card for one docs page.

GET /preview/[...slug].name: Fetch link preview
GET /preview/[...slug].description: Returns the title, description, lead text and per-heading text a hover card shows for a page.
